# GO      - the Go mnemonic that assembles this form, by the renaming rules in
#           cmd/internal/obj/arm64/doc.go. A dash means no rule found one, which is

# MASK    - the bits this encoding fixes.
# BASE    - those bits' value, with every operand field zero. OR the operands in and
#           the result is the argument to WORD: see README.md.
# FIELDS  - the operand fields, high bit first, each with its width.
